Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error in data extraction and classification by failing to verify the specific job titles of the individuals listed in the search results. In Step 3, the agent identified "Silmara Kuster" and "Adva Schulman" as "current C-suite members" based on a search snippet that only listed them as "HR Manager" and "General Counsel" respectively. The agent incorrectly assumed these roles constituted C-suite positions without verifying if they held higher executive titles (like VP or Director) or if the search results were incomplete. This led to the false conclusion that they were current C-suite members who were absent during the IPO, whereas the ground truth indicates they were never C-suite members at all. This error stems from over-reliance on unverified search snippets and a failure to cross-reference the extracted data with authoritative sources to confirm the "C-suite" status of the individuals.
